name: Hero 票券輪播構圖與動態微調版
commitAndPullRequestTitle: Apply Exhibition Hub V6.5.0-R3 ticket carousel refinement
releasePurpose: Refine the Hero ticket and postcard carousel layout, arrow style, overlap, blur depth and rotating poses while keeping the R2 mobile shortcuts and Huashan recovery intact.
keyFixes: Desktop Hero arrows use angle-bracket styling and sit outside the card frame
Hero ticket cards are slightly flatter and wider for a more realistic ticket ratio
Ticket and postcard overlap is reduced on both desktop and mobile
Back pair and incoming pair use soft blur depth until they move forward
Three rotating composition poses cycle through visible and queued pairs
Promotion and demotion transitions now include a subtle angle change
Keep mobile swipe navigation and four home quick actions from R2
Bump frontend cache version to 6.5.0-r3 for reliable production refresh
